description.narrative: Partner : Young Scientists Kenya Project Title: Project has no specific Title Project Objective: YSK seeks to inspire and empower the next generation of young scientists, innovators and entrepreneurs to transform their local and global communities through Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics (STEM).YSK does this through three pillars – Outreach, Exhibition, and Boot camp. These pillars are designed to spark young Kenyans' interest in STEM subjects and careers build their confidence and ability to solve complex problems and, overall, to provide an enabling environment for learning and innovation. Project Activities: The main programs to be supported are Outreach, Exhibition and Boot camp. Each of these YSK programs has a direct impact on our ‘Leave No Learner Behind’ approach to reach both students in marginalised areas and students with special needs. List of Key partners: Ministry of Education Kenya, Embassy of Ireland in Kenya, Safaricom, Strathmore University, Institute of Physics, Premchandbhai Foundation, Liquid Intelligent Technologies.
